items.Sentence: The screening consists of a Parkson HLS500 Hycor Helisieve automatic screen to remove inorganics larger than 1/4"
grit removal occurs in a manually scraped grit channel
Magnesium hydroxide is added via a variable speed auger to maintain optimal pH in the nitrification/denitrification activated sludge process
Influent flow emergency storage or equalization is provided, as needed, in the original primary clarifier no longer needed with the new treatment process

Advanced secondary treatment is provided by two parallel nitrification/denitrification activated sludge processes (two basins and two secondary clarifiers)

Tertiary filtration is provided by a disk filter and sand filter in series operation

The final effluent is dechlorinated prior to discharge to Deer Creek

Secondary waste activated sludge is stored in an aerated day tank, dewatered by a belt filter press
Biosolids are collected in a truck trailer before they are hauled off-site to a landfill
